title: Deforestation
description: Clearing forest for crops and pasture releases CO₂, and so does peat drained for farming. A diet shift already changes both, through production.

deforestation.title: Deforestation stopped
deforestation.description: Share of the forest clearing for farming that stops.

peatRewetting.title: Drained peat rewetted
peatRewetting.description: Share of the peat and other organic soils drained for farming that is rewetted. About 24 million hectares emit 0.8 Gt of CO₂ and 0.34 Mt of N₂O a year. When rewetted, they emit about 5 Mt of methane instead. On rewetted land, farming stops or switches to crops that grow in water.
